title: Storytelling Night—"GOOSEBUMPS"
description: ​**In honor of Halloween, our theme for October is GOOSEBUMPS 👻** ​But we don't only want the scary moments, we are looking for all the moments that made your skin prickle. Fear, love, awe, ecstasy, intuition, dread, wonder. ​Give us stories that chilled you, haunted you, or left you breathless. Emotional, supernatural, or anything that hit you so deeply that your body reacted along with your soul. ​**As always, interpret the theme freely.** **Please come just to listen or get on stage,** be vulnerable, and share with us, a diverse group of welcoming and open people who are curious about each others' lives. Stories will last from 7 to 10 minutes. Expect ten stories plus an intermission. **We will hold our event at Fábrica Braço de Prata,** an enormous multi-roomed centro cultural in Marvila that hosts everything from salsa bands to intimate piano concerts to philosophical comedy. To accommodate everyone, we will be in the outdoor tent right inside the gate to Fábrica Braço de Prata. **Storytelling Lisboa is a completely free event run by volunteers.** We welcome everyone to get on stage! Absolutely no experience is necessary. We only ask that stories be true and personal and that they are performed as opposed to read—and they should be stories instead of philosophical musings, motivational speeches, or stand-up routines. The content is completely at the discretion of the storyteller as long as it is related in the monthly theme and respectful to the diversity and experiences of all humans. **Interested in sharing a story?** We give spots on a first come, first serve basis. Please fill out our form here: [https://forms.gle/kkGhEM47BLF4WRkg9](https://forms.gle/kkGhEM47BLF4WRkg9) **We now have an email list** to subscribe to keep up with events. You can [subscribe with this link](http://eepurl.com/iXpMeI). We also have [a WhatsApp Group ](https://chat.whatsapp.com/BpN6iJGSp8fCnzKA0TSRra)if you prefer to get updates directly to your phone! For any questions or concerns, reach out to us by DM on our instagram [@storytellinglisboa](https://www.instagram.com/storytellinglisboa)! Or email storytellinglisboa at gmail dot com. **Bring some cash to throw into our donation jar!** We will always be free and want everyone to be able to attend, but your funds help sustain the increasing effort and volunteers needed to put on the event. We also have a podcast if you want to enjoy stories from home called **[What Lingers.](https://www.instagram.com/whatlingerspod)** You can find it on all podcast platforms! All links related to Storytelling Lisboa can additionally be found on our linktree: [https://linktr.ee/storytellinglisboa](https://linktr.ee/storytellinglisboa)

description: Hello People Of Lisbon! It's been a while since we had a good old-fashioned People Of Lisbon free-for-all gathering, so we're putting that right! On **Thursday, October 29th**, we're getting everyone together at the wonderful **Uva Livre**, in the very good company of Irish sommelier, wine expert and all-round raconteur **Justin O'Hanlon**. Justin knows a thing or two about wine, has a story or two to tell, and even once had the pleasure of serving the great Anthony Bourdain. So we reckon we're in good hands! More than 225 films later, we've become something much bigger. We make documentaries, take portraits, publish stories, produce podcasts, organise gatherings and bring people together through our growing community, Club People Of Lisbon. www.peopleoflisbon.com And really, that's what this evening is all about. Bringing people together. Whether you've appeared in one of our films, you're a member of our club, you've been following us for years, you've just arrived in Lisbon or you've never heard of us before, **you're very welcome**. Come alone, bring a friend, bring five friends. Expect good wine, interesting characters, lively conversations, old friends, new friends and hopefully a few stories worth remembering. No agenda, no speeches, no fuss. Just a great big merry get-together with the People Of Lisbon. **All are welcome.** Let's make it a good one! title: Open Coffee Lisbon Web Summit Special#53
description: Venue change = Impact Hub Lisbon , 3rd Floor Big thanks to Mariana and the team at [Impact Hub](https://lisbon.impacthub.net/) for providing the venue. Impact Hub don't sell coffee so we will have an "honesty jar" if you use their machine. If Open Coffee participants want to stay on/use their great co-working facilitiies, Impact Hub offer 1/2 day passes at 15 Euros. Open Coffee Lisbon is a friendly informal networking event for entrepreneurs, professionals, locals, guests, people in the startup community, and students in Lisbon.⁣ Your hosts for our event will be Richard and Giselle, with support from the Open Coffee Lisbon team. You may find a mentor, investor, client, co founder, employer, vendor, inspiration or a friend. Please post your contact details, a link to your Linkedin and/webpage in this group chat, and in our WhatsApp group https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY?mode=gi_t [here](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY?mode=gi_t)[ ](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY) We start at 09:30 AM sharp. Everybody gets up to 2 minutes to present: 1. Who they are and what they are doing 2. What they want 3. How they can help others At 10:30 AM we stop hosting and you can chat and network with the people who are most interesting to you. We are focused on business and social entrepreneurs, the startup community and anyone else who is doing something interesting or wants to get involved in other people's projects. You can talk about any project/topic. Open Coffee Lisbon is an “un-meeting” without a speaker or agenda. We are focused on attendees gaining value from other attendees. The rules, tools, structure and moderation aim to facilitate this goal. ⁣⁣What is the BIG idea behind Open Coffee? We want to help people create useful business connections.⁣ Everyone is welcome to our meetings, and we especially love first-timers.⁣ ⁣We want to make sure that if somebody coming from an unsupportive background/country has the courage to join, they will notice that we are glad they came because we welcome them. If you feel shy, you can also just listen but we encourage you to talk. Each attendee can also get to show their LinkedIn page or website through our channels and showcase their idea.⁣ This event is based on the Open Coffee Krakow format, run by Richard Lucas and others in Krakow Poland since 2012. If you want to help and get involved in making this gathering a regular part of the Lisbon eco-system please let us know [here](https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9) https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9 if you are interested in knowing more about the Open Coffee format, take a look at our video for potential leaders [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z99E2z8anFU).
